meta_description: Top Electrical Services Ltd in Nottingham. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, testing, and emergency repairs. Call 07934 353653 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Fuse box trip at 11pm? We're here. Same-day repairs, rewires, and installations across Nottingham.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires and commercial installations, we handle every type of electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, or faulty sockets? We diagnose and fix faults fast, often on the same day. No charge for the call-out.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring? We replace the lot, including new fusebox installation. Brings your home up to modern safety standards and often improves insurance premiums.

services.title: Boiler and Heating Electrics
services.desc: Faulty wiring to your heating system? We specialise in electrical work for boiler installations and upgrades, ensuring safe operation.

services.title: Testing and Certification
services.desc: Electrical Installation Condition Reports (EICR) for landlords, house sales, or peace of mind. Fully compliant with building regulations.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Maintenance, installation, and fault-finding for offices and small businesses. We minimise downtime and keep your systems running reliably.

services.title: Socket and Lighting Installation
services.desc: Add new sockets, upgrade lighting circuits, or install outdoor electrics. All work tested and certified to current Building Regulations.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I couldn't stand poor workmanship and hidden charges.
about_para_1: Top Electrical Services was founded in 2006 on a simple principle: honest work at fair prices. We've grown from a one-man operation to a team of fully trained electricians serving Nottingham and the surrounding area. Every engineer is NICEIC approved and continuously trained on the latest safety standards and techniques.
about_para_2: We've earned our reputation by turning up on time, diagnosing problems properly, and explaining what needs doing before we start. Half our work comes from repeat customers and referrals—that's how you know we're doing things right. Whether it's a midnight fuse-box emergency or a planned rewire, you get the same professional, no-nonsense approach.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homes and Businesses Say

reviews.text: Called them at 10pm on a Saturday when our electrics went down. Bloke arrived before 11, found a dodgy circuit, fixed it properly and left everything safe. Not even expensive. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We had a full rewire done. The lads were tidy, professional, explained everything as they went. Certificate came through, no messing about. My landlord was really pleased. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Priya N.

reviews.text: Been using them for years now. They're honest, turn up when they say they will, and don't try to sell you stuff you don't need. That's rare. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.
